title: Random-loop Product Kernel airport-only configuration
description: Geography-neutral configuration for a flexible closed loop made only of airport-to-airport flight segments. Railway, bus, ferry, city and other multimodal nodes are outside this contract.

trip_end.description: Latest permitted first-leg departure. Final arrival may be later than trip_end but must not exceed first departure plus preferred_trip_duration_hours.

preferred_trip_duration_hours.description: Explicit hard elapsed-time cap measured from first-leg departure to final arrival.

traveler_count.description: Number of travelers whose mandatory total price must be compared.

max_browser_queries.description: Optional user-requested hard cap on browser searches. Null leaves termination to finite leg depth, the per-destination date-anchor limit, frontier exhaustion, a qualifying loop, or the user.

date_anchor_limit_per_destination.description: Maximum number of distinct dated offer anchors the browser should preserve for each observed destination.

start_after_used_legs.description: The engine normalizes this to at least min_legs - 1 so a targeted return probe can satisfy the requested minimum leg count.

primary_source_id.description: Ordered mode requires azair. Adaptive remains accepted only for legacy configurations; locked requires an explicit source.

selection_mode.description: Ordered mode is enforced by the route engine. Technical source failures advance through the registry-defined fallback chain; an ordinary business no-match backtracks, while eligible primary-source misses receive the configured challenger.

cabin_baggage.description: Explicit cabin-baggage requirement to price and verify.

checked_bag_count.description: Explicit number of checked bags to include in the mandatory total price.

quality_gate.description: Quality policy measured per unit of the configured base currency. Per-leg efficiency is decision support by default; the rebuilt complete-loop floor is the default hard efficiency rule.

minimum_leg_efficiency_km_per_base_curre.description: Optional user-requested hard per-leg floor. Null keeps every hard-valid leg available for AI branch decisions and uses the complete-loop floor as the default efficiency gate.

minimum_complete_loop_efficiency_km_per_.description: Required hard floor for the rebuilt complete loop, expressed as distance per unit of base_currency.

target_complete_loop_efficiency_km_per_b.description: Optional target at or above the complete-loop minimum. The engine uses the minimum when this field is omitted.

maximum_leg_price.description: Optional hard exclusive per-flight price cap after FX normalization. A leg priced exactly at the cap is rejected. Null disables the cap.

maximum_leg_price_currency.description: Currency of maximum_leg_price; it must have an fx_to_base entry. When a cap is present and this field is omitted, the engine uses base_currency.

fx_to_base.description: Positive rates into base_currency. The entry named by base_currency is required and must equal 1.

then.description: The deterministic engine additionally enforces min_legs <= max_legs.

items.description: IATA airport code; no country or region is fixed by the product.
